tools.name: list_phones
tools.description: List this project's phones and their status.

tools.name: create_phone
tools.description: Create a phone, wait until it is ready and return its first screen. Give each task or end user its own phone. Phones are cloud Android; iOS and real devices are early access.

tools.name: start_phone
tools.description: Resume a parked phone. Its apps and logins are kept.

tools.name: park_phone
tools.description: Park a phone: shuts it down and stops billing. Apps, data and logins stay; apps start fresh after start_phone (like after a reboot). Park only a phone you will resume.

tools.name: delete_phone
tools.description: Delete a phone and everything on it. Do this when done with a disposable phone.

tools.name: set_device
tools.description: Set where the phone is: timezone (IANA), locale (BCP-47), GPS location, and proxy (socks5://user:pass@host:port; all traffic leaves through it, null = direct). Kept across park/start. Changing the locale restarts the UI (~15 s).

tools.name: install_app
tools.description: Install or update an app from a public download URL: an APK (arm64-v8a or universal) or a split bundle (.apks/.xapk; the splits this phone needs are picked). Then open it with act {"type":"open_app","package":…}.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Apps the user installed on this phone.

tools.name: uninstall_app
tools.description: Uninstall an app and delete its data.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Read the current screen as a numbered element list.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Run 1–20 actions in order, stop at the first failure, return results and the new screen. Types: tap, long_press, swipe, scroll, scroll_to {text}, type, key, back, home, open_app, close_app (force-stop), wait, wait_for. Target: {"text":"OK"} | {"ref":3} | {"id":"…"} | {"desc":"…"} | {"x":540,"y":1200

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: PNG of the screen, for content the element list cannot show (images, maps, games).
